L001.transcript: Rep: Hi, this is Alex from SecureAuto calling for James Hartwell. We have a great car insurance offer tailored for you. Please call us back at 555-9000. Thank you and have a great day.
Rep: Hello James, this is Alex from SecureAuto again. I wanted to follow up on our car insurance offer. We'd love to connect at your convenience. Please reach us at 555-9000.
Rep: Hi James, Alex here from SecureAuto. Third attempt to reach you about our car insurance program. Please give us a call back at 555-9000 when you get a chance.

L002.transcript:
Rep: Hi, is this Sandra Kim?
Lead: Yes, who is this?
Rep: Hi Sandra, this is Maria from SecureAuto. I'm reaching out about a car insurance offer we have for you.
Lead: Oh, I'm actually in the middle of something right now. Can you call me back?
Rep: Of course! When would be a good time?
Lead: Try me again next Thursday, maybe around 2pm. That works better for me.
Rep: Absolutely, I'll schedule that for Thursday the 30th at 2pm. Talk to you then!
Lead: Perfect, thanks.
Rep: Called Sandra Kim at 11am. Phone rang 6 times and went to voicemail. Did not leave a message as callback was already scheduled for Thursday.

L003.transcript:
Rep: Hello, may I speak with Robert Dunn?
Lead: I think you have the wrong number. There's no Robert here.
Rep: Oh I'm sorry, is this 555-0103?
Lead: Yes but there's no Robert at this number. Please stop calling.
[Lead hangs up]

Rep: Hi, could I speak with Robert Dunn please?
Lead: I already told you people, wrong number. Do not call again.
[Lead hangs up immediately]

L004.transcript:
Rep: Hi Patricia, this is Tom from SecureAuto. I'm calling about a car insurance offer.
Lead: I already have car insurance and I'm happy with my current provider.
Rep: Understood! We might be able to offer you a better rate. Would you be open to a quick comparison?
Lead: No, I'm really not interested. Please don't call again.
Rep: Of course, I'll make a note of that. Sorry to bother you.
Lead: Thank you.

Rep: Hi Patricia, this is Sarah from SecureAuto—
Lead: I told the last person I am not interested and not to call. Please remove me from your list.
Rep: I sincerely apologize, I'll make sure that happens right away.
[Call ends]

Rep: Hello, may I speak with Patricia—
[Lead hangs up immediately]

L006.transcript:
Rep: Good morning, is this Denise Fuller?
Lead: Yeah, what do you want?
Rep: Hi Denise, I'm calling from SecureAuto about a car insurance—
Lead: Not interested. [Hangs up]

Rep: Hi Denise, this is Chris from SecureAuto—
Lead: I said not interested. Stop calling. [Hangs up]

L007.transcript:
Rep: Hi Alan, this is Rachel from SecureAuto. Calling about our car insurance plans.
Lead: Oh yeah, I've been meaning to look into that actually.
Rep: Great! We have a comprehensive plan starting at $89 a month.
Lead: That sounds reasonable. What does it cover?
Rep: It covers collision, liability, and comprehensive damage. We can also add roadside assistance.
Lead: Interesting. What about deductibles?
Rep: You can choose between $500 and $1000 deductibles depending on your premium preference.
Lead: Okay, I need to look at my current policy and compare. Can you call me back tomorrow?
Rep: Absolutely! What time works?
Lead: Maybe around 11am?
Rep: Perfect, I'll call you tomorrow at 11am. Talk soon!
Lead: Sounds good, thanks.
Rep: Called Alan Marsh at 11am as scheduled. Phone rang 8 times, no answer, no voicemail set up. Will attempt again later.

L008.transcript: Rep: Hi Carol, this is Jenny from SecureAuto. Reaching out about a car insurance offer. Please call us back at 555-9000.

Rep: Hi Carol, Jenny from SecureAuto. Following up on our insurance offer.
Lead: Oh yes! I actually saw your voicemail. I'm a retired teacher and my kids keep telling me I should get better coverage.
Rep: That's great Carol! We have excellent plans for retired individuals.
Lead: What would it cost for a 2020 Camry?
Rep: For your profile it would be around $75 a month with full coverage.
Lead: That's actually less than what I pay now! Can I think about it tonight and you call me tomorrow?
Rep: Of course! I'll call you tomorrow morning.
Lead: Perfect dear, talk to you then!

Rep: Good morning Carol! It's Jenny from SecureAuto.
Lead: Jenny! Yes, I talked to my husband and we'd like to go ahead with the plan.
Rep: Wonderful! Let me get the paperwork started.
Lead: How do we proceed?
Rep: I'll send you the documents by email and we'll get you set up today.
Lead: Excellent, thank you so much!
Rep: Thank you Carol, welcome to SecureAuto!

L009.transcript:
Rep: Hi Steven, this is Mike from SecureAuto about our car insurance plans.
Lead: Sure, I'm listening.
Rep: We have plans starting at $89 a month with full coverage.
Lead: That's pretty steep for me right now. I'm self-employed and cash flow is tight.
Rep: I understand, we do have more basic plans starting at $55 a month.
Lead: Hmm, that's more like it. Can you send me some details and call back next week?
Rep: Absolutely, I'll email you the brochure and call you Monday.
Lead: Works for me.
Rep: Called Steven Park on Monday at 10am as promised. No answer, left voicemail mentioning the $55 basic plan.
Rep: Second follow-up call. Steven did not answer. Did not leave another voicemail to avoid appearing pushy.

L010.transcript: Rep: Called Linda Chang, no answer. Left voicemail about SecureAuto insurance offer.
Rep: Second attempt. Linda did not answer. No voicemail left.
Rep: Hi Linda, this is Dana from SecureAuto. Third time reaching out about our car insurance plans. We'd love to help you find coverage that fits your budget. Please call us at 555-9000.
Rep: Fourth attempt. Linda still not answering. Considering disqualification.
